On Sun, Apr 6, 2025 at 10:33 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Laura/Ben: Marta has flagged the 'custody' definition in §1.4 and asked for an ETA on our position and on whether the Order Form must include region-locked terms.

Thanks — quick technical/ops input from my side:
- EU-only hosting: We can offer a Dedicated EU pool (reserved capacity) that keeps all inference in-region and satisfies data residency guarantees. That requires an Order Form addendum and changes to our provisioning cadence; rough delta in lead time is ~4–6 weeks and estimated monthly uplift is ~20–35% depending on required throughput. See attached estimate.
- SCCs/TIA route: If CustCorp prefers standard Hosted with SCCs + Transfer Impact Addendum, we can provide our SCCs matrix, subprocessors list, and evidence of implementation (kms boundaries, egress controls). This route is faster to enable but doesn't give the EU-only operational guarantee.
- On the 'custody' wording: Our engineering/legal implementation maps 'custody' to custody of customer keys and log access controls rather than model weights. If CustCorp needs 'custody' to mean full control of model artifacts and weights, that triggers a different product/deployment conversation (private, air-gapped option).

Attachments: hosting-capacity-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Ask: Marta — can you confirm whether CustCorp's compliance bar requires EU-only residency in the SLA (hard requirement) or whether SCCs + TIA is acceptable for now? We'll prepare both an Order Form addendum draft (for Dedicated EU) and a TIA template for legal to pick from.

-Ben
Principal Contracts Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@custcorp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Apr 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs comments (custody language)

Marta — thanks for the detailed redlines. I reviewed the DPA draft and the SCCs comments. High-level position and proposed language below.

1) 'Custody' definition (§1.4):
We propose the following replacement text (tracked change):
"'Custody' means technical and administrative controls exercised by the Processor to protect Customer Data in transit and at rest, including key management, restricted administrative access, and audit trail retention. Custody does not by itself imply transfer of ownership of model artifacts or training weights unless expressly agreed in the Order Form or separate SOW."

Rationale: preserves your requirement for strong technical controls while leaving model artifact ownership separate (avoids unexpected product change).

2) EU-hosting / Order Form routing:
- If CustCorp requires a contractual EU-only residency guarantee with operational enforcement, we are prepared to accept via an Order Form hosting addendum that provisions a Dedicated EU pool (Ben's estimate attached). That will be treated as a pricing and provisioning change (we will need signature on the corresponding Order Form change).
- If CustCorp can accept SCCs + a TIA, we'll provide our SCCs matrix and subprocessors evidence, plus a short TIA describing mitigations and residual risk.

3) Next steps & timelines:
- Laura (redlines): I will produce a redline response to the DPA by EOD Tue (PST) and include the proposed custody language.
- Ben (ops): please prepare the Order Form addendum draft and the hosting uplift numbers in the xlsx; flag any minimum commitment requirements.
- Sean: please propose 3 time windows for a 30-min legal alignment call (Wed CET preferred).

I'll also share the DPA redline (Doc) and a suggested TIA template via the Drive link below for your counsel to review before the call.
